closed.reason: test_quality_runs_worktree_tools_in_ci_order now clears inherited RH_MEMORY_ROOT via monkeypatch.delenv and test_quality_ci_order_ignores_inherited_memory_root guards the fix.

statement: test_quality_runs_worktree_tools_in_ci_order does not clear an inherited RH_MEMORY_ROOT environment variable, causing scripts/check-quality.sh to append --memory to rh-validate and fail the default CI-order assertion whenever RH_MEMORY_ROOT is exported.
